title: Toy block
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id='front' x1='0' y1='0' x2='1' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0' stop-color='#ff5a4a'/>
      <stop offset='1' stop-color='#e03020'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='top' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0' stop-color='#ff9a8a'/>
      <stop offset='1' stop-color='#ff7060'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='side' x1='0' y1='0' x2='1' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0' stop-color='#c82018'/>
      <stop offset='1' stop-color='#a01410'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='stud' x1='0' y1='0' x2='1' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0' stop-color='#ffb0a0'/>
      <stop offset='1' stop-color='#ff8070'/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- right face -->
  <polygon points='70,38 88,30 88,72 70,80' fill='url(#side)'/>

  <!-- top face -->
  <polygon points='20,38 70,38 88,30 38,30' fill='url(#top)'/>

  <!-- front face -->
  <rect x='20' y='38' width='50' height='42' rx='2' fill='url(#front)'/>

  <!-- studs on top -->
  <ellipse cx='33' cy='30' rx='7' ry='3.5' fill='url(#stud)'/>
  <ellipse cx='33' cy='27' rx='7' ry='3.5' fill='#ffd0c8'/>
  <ellipse cx='57' cy='30' rx='7' ry='3.5' fill='url(#stud)'/>
  <ellipse cx='57' cy='27' rx='7' ry='3.5' fill='#ffd0c8'/>

  <!-- highlight on front -->
  <rect x='25' y='44' width='8' height='30' rx='4' fill='#ff8a7a' opacity='0.55'/>

  <!-- smiley face on front block -->
  <circle cx='37' cy='56' r='3' fill='#ffd54a'/>
  <circle cx='54' cy='56' r='3' fill='#ffd54a'/>
  <path d='M36 65 Q45.5 73 55 65' stroke='#ffd54a' stroke-width='3.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
</svg>
